tickets.title: Run a catalogue-to-screen walking skeleton
tickets.delivers: Start development Compose and view a labelled example product loaded from PostgreSQL through the core and HTTP into Studio.
acceptance: TypeScript/pnpm, Next.js and real PostgreSQL work with Knex/pg and repeatable Knex migrations; no additional application ORM.
An example exact variant/offer renders through core → HTTP → UI; development fixtures are separate from live data.
One-command startup, health checks, schema ordering, AGPL notices and focused integration/type checks are demonstrated.

tickets.title: Create the first administrator and private workspace
tickets.delivers: Claim setup once and sign in to an isolated private workspace.
acceptance: Verify a Knex-backed Better Auth adapter and the required atomic/transaction behavior; reconcile schema requirements with Knex migrations.
An installation-held one-time token atomically creates the first administrator and workspace, disables setup and works without SMTP.
Email/password sign-in/out and invitation-only admission enforce trusted workspace authorization in core and HTTP, including direct-call and two-workspace tests.
Deliver responsive English/Dutch Studio setup/sign-in screens without asserting email verification from operator provisioning.

tickets.title: Manage devices, sessions and password changes
tickets.delivers: Inspect devices, revoke sessions and change the account password after recent authentication.
acceptance: Enforce secure HTTP-only database-backed sessions, seven-day inactivity expiry and thirty-day absolute maximum with time-controlled tests.
List devices and sign out current/all devices with server-verified revocation.
Require recent authentication for password changes and sensitive credential-creation authorization; email-address changes are delivered with the SMTP-backed account flows.
Test invalid input, stale/revoked identities, account isolation and supported CSRF/origin protections.

tickets.title: Configure SMTP and test transactional delivery
tickets.delivers: Configure protected email settings and deliberately send a diagnostic message.
acceptance: Administration stores masked/protected SMTP settings and exposes connection/delivery failure states.
Use a local test inbox for repeatable verification; real recipients/credentials are explicitly configured, not inferred.
Provide a reusable mailer outcome contract and English/Dutch UI; secrets never reach logs, model context or browser output.

tickets.title: Invite shoppers, change email and recover passwords
tickets.delivers: Invite a shopper into their own private workspace and recover access using expiring email links.
acceptance: Seven-day invitations are single-use/email-bound, create a private workspace and do not share another shopper's data.
Thirty-minute reset links are atomically single-use and revoke existing browser sessions; responses do not enumerate accounts.
Normal delivery requires configured SMTP; verify unavailable/delivery-failure, expiry, replay and concurrent-consumption behavior.
Document and exercise a separate operator-only administrator recovery route, not a public password override.
Email-address changes require recent authentication and confirmation of the new address before switching account identity; unavailable email cannot report a completed change.

tickets.title: Add optional authenticator two-factor authentication
tickets.delivers: Enroll a second factor and recover through one-time backup codes.
acceptance: Enrollment requires recent authentication and a verified authenticator code; provide protected recovery codes.
Enabled second-factor requirements apply to sign-in and sensitive changes; backup codes are atomically single-use.
Password reset alone cannot bypass the second factor; document separate recovery and test incorrect/replayed codes across responsive account screens.

tickets.title: Manage the Netherlands retailer registry
tickets.delivers: Inspect, add and pause sources with separate eligibility, permission and extraction-health states.
acceptance: Idempotently seed the researched fourteen entries as candidates while retaining administrator edits; no scraping permission or working adapter is assumed.
Separate platform domains, actual sellers, categories, Netherlands delivery evidence and source acquisition policy/adapter health.
Newly discovered sources remain candidates; support administrator control without closing discovery to the seed list or influencing rank by popularity/affiliate revenue.
Test source-state changes, duplicates, unauthorized edits, last-failure visibility and seed updates.
tickets.reason: source registry removed; knowledge kept in docs/retailer-registry.md

tickets.title: Connect models through Vercel AI SDK provider adapters
tickets.delivers: Configure API-key or compatible/local AI models and exercise a bounded SDK capability-test request from settings.
acceptance: Verify OpenAI/Anthropic API-key adapters and a configurable compatible/local endpoint, with pinned/documented capability support.
Protect installation defaults and workspace overrides; expose model/usage-source choices and optional extraction overrides without leaking secrets.
Diagnostic requests have explicit call/token bounds and test typed tools/streaming/structured output; no hidden fallback or unattended personal-key use.
Use deterministic provider fixtures, isolation/redaction checks and separately configured live smoke checks.

Use verified Vercel AI SDK provider adapters behind the shared model registry; compatible endpoints need tested tool/structured-output/streaming support rather than an assumed compatibility label. Preserve BYOK/local operation without requiring a gateway.

tickets.title: Enforce research and monitoring budgets
tickets.delivers: Set allowances and see provider work pause when a budget is exhausted.
acceptance: Installation ceilings cannot be bypassed by workspace overrides; interactive and background allowances are separate.
Coordinate concurrent reservations, usage and bounded retries; disclose conservative cost estimates where exact pre-call pricing is unavailable.
Require personal-key background consent and explicit paid/provider fallback; expose usage and pause reasons in settings/test execution.
Prove limits on simultaneous work, cancellation/retries and absence of silent paid-key fallback.

tickets.title: Ingest a product page with inspectable evidence
tickets.delivers: Submit a permitted product URL and inspect its persisted product, variant, offer and claims.
acceptance: Bound fetching, validate source policy/network destinations and classify redirects/challenges/errors, including HTTP 200 challenge pages.
Parse structured product/offer data, preserving identifiers, actual seller, evidence excerpts and source/observation times with Knex.
Only merge agreeing identities/configurations; retailer SKUs are retailer-local and ambiguity remains explicit.
Details/core/HTTP checks prove idempotence, unsafe-URL rejection, variant conflicts and failed extraction never overwriting valid observations.

tickets.title: Normalize attributes and review conflicting claims
tickets.delivers: Inspect canonical attributes and resolve validated mappings or merge conflicts without losing evidence.
acceptance: Support extensible category attributes/types/units/synonyms and common fields without excluding unknown categories.
Preserve source claims; parser/model proposals cannot silently activate invented filters or resolve conflicts.
Administrator correction/review focuses on unresolved mappings/merges and invalidates affected assessments; supported routine ingestion remains automatic.
Test mixed categories, units, contradictory variants and unauthorized/non-destructive correction through details and administration.

tickets.title: Search catalogue identifiers, filters and bilingual text
tickets.delivers: Find products by exact model, structured criteria or English/Dutch wording.
acceptance: Combine parameterized Knex identifier/filter queries with PostgreSQL full-text and pg_trgm retrieval; preserve model identifiers.
Test bilingual synonyms/query expansion and typo/mixed-language cases; stemming alone is not cross-language proof.
Unknown attributes do not become verified matches; cards/details expose sources, uncertainty and timestamps.
Responsive search/empty/error states work without model/embedding services; check behavior and representative PostgreSQL query performance.

tickets.title: Discover external candidates using SearXNG
tickets.delivers: Search beyond the catalogue and inspect source-linked candidates.
acceptance: Configure an external instance or optional Compose profile and verify JSON/language support and missing-provider states.
Bound calls, retain query/provider/URL provenance and apply source policy; new domains do not gain unrestricted ingestion privileges.
Search snippets and locale hints are discovery signals, not product/price/delivery verification.
Candidate UI can send supported URLs through ingestion; fixture and opt-in live checks cover bad JSON, duplicates and no-Tavily operation.

tickets.title: Configure Tavily Search and Extract independently
tickets.delivers: Mix search/extraction providers and control any paid fallback.
acceptance: Support independent Tavily Search/Extract choices including SearXNG discovery with Tavily extraction.
Route returned evidence through existing identity, permission and catalogue validation rather than treating raw content as verified.
Paid calls and fallback are enabled explicitly and bounded by shared budgets; configuration and exhaustion are visible.
Verify combinations, source failures, redaction and usage accounting with fixtures and separately configured live checks.

tickets.title: Make extraction resilient and expose source coverage
tickets.delivers: Extract supported non-structured pages and inspect source-specific reliability.
acceptance: Add readable-content and evidence-linked structured model extraction plus maintained source-specific adapters where needed; never guess missing required fields.
Coordinate per-host concurrency, public-request deduplication, cache-context isolation and bounded Retry-After/backoff; record access blocks instead of evasion.
Retain fetch/source cache times, adapter versions, required-field coverage and last success/failure; layout changes cannot erase good observations.
Use reviewed fixtures and a small permitted cross-category live pilot. No universal retailer support or mandatory browser-automation service is implied.

tickets.title: Stream persistent bilingual chat with Vercel AI SDK
tickets.delivers: Describe a need in a real SDK-backed streaming chat, answer clarification questions and revisit persisted structured requirements.
acceptance: Vercel AI SDK typed tools produce visible must-haves/preferences/assumptions in English/Dutch under core authorization.
Persist session messages and authoritative structured requirements/questions separately; summaries cannot override them.
Ask material questions, preserve must-haves and record revisions; implement session navigation in the responsive Studio shell.
Verify reload/isolation, bounded secret-free context, invalid model output and provider/budget failure states.

Use the pinned Vercel AI SDK server streaming/typed message APIs and its React useChat integration with an authenticated transport; render text, typed tool states and structured-result references rather than flattening everything to prose.

Provide bounded requirements/clarification tools calling the authorized core. Persist model/UI messages and structured state; reload/context assembly keeps workspace data isolated and excludes credentials.

Verify a real request through the SDK runtime using deterministic model/provider fixtures, including streaming tool results, malformed output, cancellation/error display and persistence; a static mocked chat transcript is not completion.

tickets.title: Run the controlled Vercel AI SDK shopping agent loop
tickets.delivers: A shopper request causes a bounded multi-step agent to search catalogue evidence, evaluate fit and present structured recommendations or material clarification.
acceptance: Implement controlled requirements → catalogue search → gap assessment → evaluation → presentation with phase-scoped shopping tools.
Code checks identity, business seller, Netherlands eligibility, condition, EUR/VAT/shipping and must-have evidence; models explain subjective trade-offs.
Separate verified/uncertain candidates and incomplete/conditional prices; affiliate revenue cannot change ranking.
Persist result references and historical/fresh distinctions; test heterogeneous categories, false variants, postcode context, six-hour offer and thirty-day spec policy.

Implement the selected ToolLoopAgent abstraction using the pinned AI SDK version. The SDK owns model → tool call → tool result → next model step; do not hand-roll a second competing tool-calling protocol loop.

The application owns explicit requirements/catalogue/gap/evaluation/presentation phases and permitted transitions. Use documented per-step controls (such as prepareStep) to assemble bounded messages and select tools; every core operation separately enforces access and permitted actions.

Register typed shopping tools for requirement updates, catalogue search, evidence inspection, candidate evaluation, clarification and result presentation, backed by actual core operations. Do not expose raw database/network credentials or a generic SQL tool.

At each step, assemble context from authoritative requirements, recent messages, candidate/evidence references and current gaps. Tool results carry structured identifiers/evidence/gaps/errors, not unbounded raw pages.

Configure explicit documented loop stopping controls (such as stopWhen) and application guards for step/token/cost/time allowances. A model finishing its answer is not by itself proof of sufficient research: verify deterministic evidence conditions or return clarification/partial/unavailable.

Record inspectable phase/tool/progress outcomes without secrets. Verify multiple SDK steps, a clarification stop, denied out-of-phase tools, missing/conflicting evidence and a premature model finish through public research results and trace events.

tickets.title: Checkpoint and recover the SDK agent loop in durable workers
tickets.delivers: Start an SDK agent run, observe persisted progress, cancel or continue it, and resume from a worker checkpoint after restart.
acceptance: Persist phases, revisions, candidates, evidence, gaps and usage in PostgreSQL-backed worker execution; document its Knex/pool integration.
Enforce three-minute/eight-discovery/twenty-page/thirty-candidate/twelve-step caps plus token/spending limits, including retries.
Continuation adds explicit bounded allowance; cancellation/exhaustion retains supported partial results.
Verify restart/lease recovery, concurrent workers, duplicate work and owner revocation before more execution/spending.

Wrap the same agent execution in the durable worker rather than replacing its orchestration with an unrelated agent framework. Persist phase, requirement revision, safe messages/tool-result references, pending work, evidence and consumed usage at recoverable boundaries.

Keep per-run/allowance step and spending counters cumulative across phase calls and restarts. A fresh SDK invocation or worker retry must not reset the accepted ceilings; explicit continuation is the only way to add allowance within installation/workspace limits.
Clarification records a waiting-for-user state and resumes against the new requirement revision; reconnecting the browser reloads stored progress rather than initiating duplicate work.

SDK in-memory state is not durable storage. Test provider-response/checkpoint failure boundaries, idempotent tool effects, changed requirements and owner revocation without promising exactly-once external model calls.

tickets.title: Extend the same agent loop with external discovery and ingestion
tickets.delivers: When the catalogue cannot support the request, the existing SDK agent researches targeted external gaps, admits validated evidence and re-evaluates the shortlist.
acceptance: Apply task-specific sufficiency and candidate diversity, not a result-count-only completion rule.
Plan focused Dutch/English/exact-model queries and ingest only validated permitted public evidence.
Preserve identity uncertainty/conflicts and exclude private requirements/postcodes from shared catalogue facts.
Test source injection, failed refresh/cache behavior and provider/cap limits; show coverage and honest completion/partial reasons with an opt-in live smoke flow.

Expose configured SearXNG/Tavily discovery and permitted built-in/Tavily evidence retrieval as typed tools only in allowed research phases. Return normalized candidate/evidence references rather than granting arbitrary database writes.
Loop from gap assessment to targeted discovery/retrieval, validated admission and evaluation; reuse the same SDK execution controls, bounded context, durable state and cumulative usage accounting.

Prove a public end-to-end SDK trace that searches the catalogue first, identifies a real evidence gap, calls an external adapter, validates the discovered variant/offer and either presents supported results or explicitly remains incomplete.
Retrieved pages cannot instruct the agent to change phases, relax must-haves or access secrets. Test malicious source instructions and repeated no-progress work under existing caps.

tickets.title: Save preferences and invalidate revised research
tickets.delivers: Explicitly reuse preferences and revise requirements without retaining invalid recommendations.
acceptance: Create/list/edit/delete saved preferences, showing when they apply; ordinary session assumptions do not become durable preferences.
Requirement changes invalidate affected assessments while preserving valid unrelated evidence and offering an explicit rerun.
Private session deletion preserves independent watch ownership/public facts; navigation and settings retain useful provider-outage behavior.
Test cross-session opt-in, two-workspace isolation, summary boundaries and historical result revisions through UI/core/HTTP.

tickets.title: Compare exact variants in persisted interactive tables
tickets.delivers: Select products and revisit requirement-driven side-by-side comparisons.
acceptance: Persist private selections/results and allow cross-category alternatives serving the same use.
Build columns from normalized requirements/evidence; distinguish unknown, disputed and inapplicable values.
Show exact variant, delivered-price completeness, freshness and source links in responsive English/Dutch tables.
Verify selection/persistence, invalid variants, keyboard/mobile operation, isolation and no-provider saved comparison access.

tickets.title: Watch an exact offer and receive target alerts
tickets.delivers: Create a daily exact-offer watch and receive qualifying in-app notifications.
acceptance: Explicit create/edit requests produce independent identity/condition/delivery/threshold settings; clarify ambiguity and confirm destructive bulk actions.
Daily Europe/Amsterdam jobs obtain fresh valid observations, expose last success/failure and disclose downtime gaps.
Implement threshold crossings and one initial qualifying alert with application-level deduplication across retries/workers.
Personal-key work needs consent/budget and current owner access. Test pause/resume, failure/staleness rejection and session independence through UI and worker execution.

tickets.title: Watch variants across sellers and meaningful price drops
tickets.delivers: Monitor an established variant while retaining seller eligibility and suppressing repetitive drops.
acceptance: Alternate offers preserve exact configuration, condition and Netherlands delivery constraints.
Establish the first successful baseline and compare later drops to the last notified price using configurable absolute/percentage minimum decrease.
Specify/replay threshold rearming, repeated prices and seller/mandatory-shipping changes without duplicate noise.
Expose observed history/gaps and distinguish advertised discount claims; test conflicts, missing prices and watch edits through the check-to-alert flow.

tickets.title: Deliver email alerts with schedules and quiet hours
tickets.delivers: Receive email alerts at suitable times and inspect failures while retaining in-app alerts.
acceptance: Persist delivery intent and application-level deduplication across workers/restarts; SMTP failures do not erase in-app alerts.
Support daily timing/quiet hours in Europe/Amsterdam with controlled DST tests.
Recheck delayed-alert relevance and owner/watch state before delivery; failed freshness validation cannot produce a current-deal claim.
Expose bounded retries and ambiguous SMTP acceptance outcomes; test stale deals, pause/disable/delete and restart behavior via captured email/UI.

tickets.title: Expose shopping operations through personal HTTP tokens
tickets.delivers: Create scoped credentials and use research, comparisons and watches through HTTP.
acceptance: Recent-auth settings create workspace-scoped tokens with chosen permissions, ninety-day default expiry, one-time display and revocation.
Expose typed core search/research lifecycle/compare/watch operations with consistent validation and documented errors.
Enforce private/background consent and bulk-write rules; no administrator/provider-secret shopping endpoints.
Test scopes, expiry/revocation, invalid input, workspace tampering and an external research-to-watch flow.

tickets.title: Connect external assistants through authenticated MCP
tickets.delivers: Authorize a client in the browser and use shopping tools through the application MCP server.
acceptance: Use a verified current transport/protocol and maintained OAuth flow for workspace-specific sign-in/consent.
Map core shopping operations/progress/results to scoped MCP tools with consistent validation and failures.
Provide connected-client display/revocation and documented supported token lifetimes, audience and consent handling.
Exercise an actual compatible client and rejected/revoked access. Do not build the withdrawn inbound extension/skill-loader feature.

tickets.title: Disable and restore users without resuming private work
tickets.delivers: Revoke access and pause private jobs/notifications while retaining restorable data.
acceptance: Administrator controls expose users/operations, not private conversations or personal credential browsing.
Disable browser/API/MCP access and prevent queued/running private work from performing further authorized actions or spending.
Pause watches/research/notifications with visible reasons; re-enabling access does not implicitly resume them.
Test authorization, job checkpoints, delayed email and sessions/tokens/grants across processes.

tickets.title: Delete private data and enforce retention
tickets.delivers: Track private cleanup while stopping spending and preserving reusable public facts.
acceptance: Confirmed recent-auth account deletion blocks access/spending immediately and tracks idempotent removal of credentials, grants and derived private data.
Provide configurable retention/cleanup status and minimize retained excerpts; document backup-retention implications.
Deleting sessions preserves independently created watches; public facts do not inherit private deletion ownership.
Test retry/resume, racing jobs, private-cache cleanup and two-workspace isolation with real storage and UI/API checks.

tickets.title: Import evidence from an approved structured source
tickets.delivers: Configure a bounded structured import and inspect normalized results, progress and failures.
acceptance: Support mapped CSV/JSON imports and one configured source-adapter contract without requiring an unavailable retailer partnership.
Apply the same provenance, identity, unit, offer and uncertainty validation as page ingestion.
Provide checkpointed/idempotent progress and partial failure visibility, retaining good facts when a source omits or withdraws fields.
Verify permitted fixtures and a real source only when available; document supported format/adapter limits rather than claiming universal API import.

tickets.title: Add optional multilingual semantic catalogue retrieval
tickets.delivers: Configure embeddings and measure descriptive retrieval against the lexical baseline.
acceptance: Optional pgvector augments exact/full-text/trigram candidates and filters; ordinary catalogue search needs no embedding credentials.
Protect provider configuration, account usage and embedding-model/version metadata; rebuild changed public representations resumably.
Show enabled/disabled/unavailable states without silent paid fallback or private-data embedding leakage.
Benchmark bilingual/descriptive/filter cases and failure modes; similarity never establishes exact identity or verified must-haves.

tickets.title: Connect eligible ChatGPT plan usage to shopping chat
tickets.delivers: Authorize a permitted ChatGPT plan connection and exercise a shopping tool step.
acceptance: Separate provider OAuth from application sign-in/invitations; protect consent, refresh/disconnect and account-specific model selection.
Verify the AI SDK route against current official streaming/Responses/tool requirements and prove more than a text-only ping.
Show eligibility/expiry/quota/usage-source states without browser-cookie reuse or silent API-key billing.

Document supported local/private-VM deployment, paid-hosting access limits and dependency licensing; use fixtures plus a configured eligible-account live test or retain a concrete unresolved entitlement gate.

tickets.title: Expose truthful Claude-plan availability in settings
tickets.delivers: See whether plan access is permitted for this deployment without losing working Claude API-key access.
acceptance: Resolve current official product versus personal-SDK guidance and document a permitted route or exact approval dependency.
Show supported/unavailable/approval-required states distinct from API-key mode; do not advertise an unverified subscription integration.
If expressly permitted, verify one bounded authenticated request; otherwise retain the unmet requirement and concrete follow-up condition.
Test capability/error states; no impersonation, credential scraping, forced replacement of the Vercel agent, invitation bypass or silent billing change.

tickets.title: Operate and restore the full self-hosted stack
tickets.delivers: Run development/production Compose and recover the system from a backup.
acceptance: Run web/API, worker, outward-facing MCP and PostgreSQL with ordered migrations and optional SearXNG; expose actual missing-capability states.
Document HTTPS/network exposure, protected secrets/encryption keys, health, upgrades, backups and operator recovery.
Demonstrate restore of representative private/public/job state without lost isolation, exceeded budgets, fabricated history or duplicate alerts.
Verify fresh-install/upgrade/degraded operation and AGPL licence/source notices; no hosted billing infrastructure is required.

tickets.title: Verify complete flows and measured release coverage
tickets.delivers: Demonstrate the complete release with an honest source/model capability and quality report.
acceptance: Consolidate checks delivered alongside every slice: English/Dutch shortlist, comparison and offer-to-watch-to-in-app/email, desktop/mobile/theme/accessibility and an MCP client.
All curated correctness/security cases pass; establish relevance targets from the reviewed cross-category benchmark and document examined coverage.
Demonstrate isolation, conflicts, budgets, freshness, lifecycle controls, restart/cancellation, quiet hours and deduplication.

Run bounded separately configured live provider/source/SMTP smoke checks and full Compose/restore evidence. Missing permissions/accounts remain explicit release gates, not fabricated success or silent removal of requested subscription support.

tickets.title: Build the invite, recovery and email-change screens
tickets.delivers: Accept an invitation, recover access and confirm an email-address change on real screens instead of a 404.
acceptance: /accept-invitation renders and consumes a single-use invitation through the existing core path.
/reset-password renders request and completion forms with explicit failures for expired, replayed and concurrently consumed tokens.
The account screen starts an email-address change and /account/email/confirm completes it.
A test asserts every API-generated link path resolves to an existing route.

tickets.title: Harden product-page ingestion
tickets.delivers: Bounded, classified fetching and identity rules that keep the catalogue trustworthy.
acceptance: Fetching is bounded and network destinations validated; redirects, challenges and HTTP 200 challenge pages are classified.
Only agreeing identities and configurations merge; retailer-local SKU ambiguity stays visible.
Idempotence, unsafe-URL rejection, variant conflicts and failed-extraction preservation are proven.
Source coverage is reported for a submitted page.

changes: Make SDK provider integration, streaming chat, controlled agent loop, durable checkpoints and external-research extension explicit in tickets 8 and 16–19. No blocker changes.

implementation.note: Ticket 07's registry was withdrawn; ticket 10 must define its own source policy concept.
